WITH RECURSIVE same_file AS (
  SELECT caller_symbol_id, callee_symbol_id
  FROM code.call_edges
  WHERE calls_directly
    AND caller_file_id = 'httpx/_client.py'
    AND callee_file_id = 'httpx/_client.py'
), reach(symbol_id) AS (
  SELECT caller_symbol_id FROM same_file WHERE callee_symbol_id = 'httpx/_client.py::Client._send_single_request'
  UNION
  SELECT e.caller_symbol_id FROM same_file e JOIN reach r ON e.callee_symbol_id = r.symbol_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT symbol_id FROM reach WHERE symbol_id <> 'httpx/_client.py::Client._send_single_request'
